<pasted_content id="b9c1">
You are an independent Opus 5 reviewer of a filled assessment.json in this blind eval workspace.
Do not try to learn which model built the artifact.
Read EVAL.md, inputs/rubric.json, and assessment.json.
Check every rating is fair and grounded in concrete evidence against inputs/ and artifact/ (and build/).
Flag any rating that is unsupported, overstated, or too harsh.
If you find issues, reconcile them by updating assessment.json (keep evidence grounded) OR write assessment.review.json with corrections alongside the original.
Stay inside this directory. When done, briefly list any changes you made.
</pasted_content id="b9c1">

Read EVAL.md and follow it exactly.
You are a blind evaluator. Do not try to discover which model built the artifact.
Work only inside this directory.
Read inputs/rubric.json, inspect artifact/ and measure against build/, compare to inputs/ and specs.
Fill assessment.json completely: every judged rating 0-4 with concrete evidence (at least two evidence items per criterion, one with measurement/path/observed behavior). For computed panelFidelity criteria, fill every measurement you can actually take; leave null only if unmeasurable.
Set evaluator to a short label (e.g. blind-evaluator), evaluatorModel to exactly claude-opus-5, and evaluatedAt to an ISO timestamp.
Keep summary under 1200 characters. Issues are objects with severity/title/detail.
Stop when assessment.json is complete and valid JSON.

Independent Phase 1 reviewer (Opus 5). Blind. Work only inside this directory.
assessment.json is filled (structure corrected: panelFidelity is top-level, not under categories). Spot-check ratings and computed measurements against EVAL.md, rubric anchors, artifact/, build/, and scratch/ outputs.
Do NOT run long Playwright loops unless a rating looks clearly wrong.
If a rating or measurement is clearly wrong, edit assessment.json. Keep evaluatorModel=claude-opus-5 and runId unchanged. No null ratings on judged criteria. Computed criteria keep measurements, rating null is fine for them only at top-level panelFidelity.
Say REVIEW_OK DONE when ready to register.
